signatures.name: Purple gradient default theme
signatures.why: Generic AI default aesthetic that erases brand.
signatures.fix: Derive palette from brand tokens; ban purple-indigo stock gradients unless on-brand.

signatures.name: Hero cluttered with stat strip
signatures.why: First viewport should do one job; stats dilute brand and CTA.
signatures.fix: Move metrics below the fold; keep hero to brand, headline, support, CTA, visual.

signatures.name: Everything in cards
signatures.why: Cards without interaction add noise and look template-generated.
signatures.fix: Use cards only for interactive units; remove chrome from static content.

signatures.name: Inset floating hero image
signatures.why: Promotional surfaces need full-bleed visual planes, not postage stamps.
signatures.fix: Make hero media edge-to-edge background or dominant plane.

signatures.name: Default Inter/Roboto stack
signatures.why: Default type stacks signal generic AI output.
signatures.fix: Choose an expressive brand font and wire it through tokens.

signatures.name: Emoji used as UI iconography
signatures.why: Emojis as icons read as placeholder marketing, not product UI.
signatures.fix: Replace with a coherent icon set sized to the design system.

signatures.name: Unmotivated glassmorphism
signatures.why: Frosted panels without hierarchy become visual noise.
signatures.fix: Use blur sparingly on true overlays; prefer solid surfaces for content.

signatures.name: Pill chip cluster clutter
signatures.why: Clusters of pills compete with the primary message.
signatures.fix: Limit chips; prefer one status treatment and structured filters.

signatures.name: Hollow AI marketing copy
signatures.why: Vague claims fail the brand test and designer review.
signatures.fix: Write concrete product outcomes and verbs tied to the UI.

signatures.name: Missing empty and error states
signatures.why: Forgotten states are a top production defect source.
signatures.fix: Specify empty, loading, error, and success for every data surface.

signatures.name: Stacked modal traps
signatures.fix: Replace nested dialogs with inline expansion or a single stepped flow.

signatures.name: Cream background serif terracotta cluster
signatures.why: Overused AI aesthetic cluster that feels unoriginal.
signatures.fix: Pick a distinct direction with intentional color and type pairing.

signatures.name: Broadsheet dense newspaper layout
signatures.why: Dense multi-column news layouts rarely fit product UI jobs.
signatures.fix: Simplify to one job per section with clear hierarchy.
